The rule rewards honesty: stating your true belief earns the most on average. Stating 95 %
        every time costs about $130k per dry well. Beware, high 3D estimates are more often
        too optimistic than cautious: a stated 80 % is actually worth around 70 %.

        that played the biggest part. A well then declines: about -12 % in the first year, a bit more than half
        the rate after 5 years.
\n Un puits en mer produit enviro:
An offshore well produces about seven times more than an onshore well, but costs six times more and
        carries heavier fixed costs.

        geology was truly tested makes them a little less promising.
